title: KKT Atlas: Learning Low-Dimensional Local Scenario Models for Contextual Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.32071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In contextual stochastic optimization, integrated learning trains conditional models on operational loss, but repeatedly solving stochastic programs with many scenarios is costly. We propose KKT Atlas, which partitions contexts into local charts and identifies a low-dimensional subspace per chart from decision gradients of the scenario cost. It generates shared scenarios by jointly fitting subspace coordinates and context-dependent probabilities. We show that one more scenario than the subspace dimension suffices to approximate the conditional Karush-Kuhn-Tucker optimality condition under regularity conditions, yielding decision and risk bounds under local strong convexity, with generalization error scaling with the compact parameter dimension. translated_title: KKT Atlas：面向情境随机优化的低维局部场景模型学习
translated_abstract: 在情境随机优化中，一体化学习基于运行损失训练条件模型，但使用大量场景反复求解随机规划代价高昂。我们提出KKT Atlas，它将情境划分为局部图册，并从场景成本的决策梯度中为每个图册识别一个低维子空间，通过联合拟合子空间坐标和情境相关概率来生成共享场景。我们证明，在正则性条件下，只需比子空间维数多一个场景即可逼近条件KKT最优性条件，并在局部强凸性下给出决策与风险界，其泛化误差随紧凑参数维数缩放。在三个合成问题上，Atlas每个决策仅需4-18个场景，而直接求解全支持一体化学习需要500个场景，它以约4-23倍的计算加速获得了相当或更低的风险。
tldr: KKT Atlas通过将情境划分为局部图册并在其中学习低维子空间，仅用4-18个场景即可逼近条件KKT最优性条件，相比需要500个场景的传统一体化学习方法实现约4-23倍加速，同时保持相当或更低的风险。
en_tdlr: KKT Atlas partitions contexts into local charts with learned low-dimensional subspaces, approximating conditional KKT optimality using only 4-18 scenarios instead of 500, achieving 4-23× speedup with comparable or lower risk.
